title: AI agents found a zero-day and used it
summary: Amazon says attackers’ agents found an unknown flaw in MONAI Label, a medical-imaging research server. CISA listed it on Monday, the day after a fixed release.

topics.angle: The one case with a CVE, a government listing and a fix.

claims.text: CISA added the flaw to its known-exploited list on November 23, with a November 26 deadline.
Agents went from mapping the server to writing files in about 11 minutes. Root came later, on one university server.
Amazon’s account is its own reconstruction and has not been independently confirmed. It does not show patient data was taken.
Version 0.8.6, released November 22, fixes it. Reports saying there is no fixed version are out of date.
Login is off by default in MONAI Label.

to_find: Amazon’s own incident report; our searches did not return it
